title: Implicit Priority Inversion via Signal Order
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] Master 0 never granted when Master 1 continuously requests
rtl:
assign gnt[0] = req[0] && !req[1];  // Overridden if both asserted
assign gnt[1] = req[1];              // Always wins — implicit priority
expected_root_cause: Two concurrent assign statements both drive the gnt bus; the second assign (gnt[1] = req[1]) always overrides the first due to last-assignment-wins semantics, giving master 1 unconditional priority over master 0.
description: Two concurrent assigns drive gnt: the second assign always wins due to last-assignment-wins semantics in simulation, giving Master 1 implicit priority over Master 0 regardless of last_gnt.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] Master 0 never granted when Master 1 continuously requests
success_log: Round-robin: both masters granted alternately under continuous concurrent requests.
